channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $67.18 per troy ounce, up 3.03% from the $65.21 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD appreciates to $4,400 as yields retreat
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends gains for the second consecutive day on Friday as the pullback in US Treasury yields has offset the negative impact of the hawkish hike delivered by the Federal Reserve (Fed) earlier this week.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Short-term range but path still lower against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes that AUD/USD has rebounded after an oversold slide, with intraday price action now expected between 0.7095 and 0.7130.

item.title: US Dollar: Post-FOMC consolidation and data focus – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategist Christopher Wong observes that the US Dollar (USD) has eased modestly as UST yields and Oil retraced from their post-FOMC spikes. He sees the move as consolidation, with further USD gains likely needing another leg higher in UST yields.

item.title: Euro: Hawkish ECB offers limited support against US Dollar - ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole highlights that recent European Central Bank commentary remains broadly hawkish, with limited pushback from the dovish camp.

item.title: Indian Rupee gets slight relief as rally in US yields and oil price hits pause
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens sharply higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, with the USD/INR pair correcting to near 95.75 from an over seven-week high of 96.10 posted the previous day.

item.title: British Pound: BoE on hold sparks Sterling softness – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Bank’s Danske Research Team highlights that the Bank of England left Bank Rate at 3.75% with a 6-3 vote, disappointing hawkish market expectations and triggering GBP weakness and lower rates.

item.title: United States Dollar Index tests late July high, near 100.35 on hawkish Fed stance
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, regains positive traction on Friday and maintains its bid tone through the first half of the European session.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Attracts slight bids below trendline near 1.3360
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.1% at around 1.3372 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday. The GBP/USD pair gains as the British currency rises, following the release of the surprisingly upbeat United Kingdom (UK) Retail Sales data for August.

item.title: WTI Oil eases to levels near $95 on hopes of higher supply of Saudi Crude
item.description: The US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil is heading for its first weekly decline in the last three weeks, as prices near the $95 level after hitting fresh four-month highs at 102.07 last Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Yen vulnerable after BoJ communication – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes that the Bank of Japan’s 25bp hike to 1.25% fell short of hawkish market pricing, triggering an initial Yen sell-off as expectations for larger moves proved overdone.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Consolidation holds below 0.8300 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes USD/CHF remains in a consolidation phase after a sharp rally, with intraday trading expected between 0.8225 and 0.8265.

item.title: ECB’s Lagarde: We'll decide on rates meeting by meeting
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said during the European trading session on Friday that the decision on interest rates by the central bank will be meeting by meeting.

item.title: Euro flattens against US Dollar as traders look beyond ECB-Fed hawkish decisions
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades in a tight range at around 1.1485 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Gold flirts with $$4,400 as softer US bond yields offset hawkish Fed and bullish USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) scales higher for the second straight day and continues to hit new weekly highs through the first half of the European session on Friday, with bulls now awaiting a move beyond the $4,400 mark before positioning for further gains.

item.title: Czech Koruna: CNB pause before potential November hike – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky notes that the Czech National Bank (CNB) kept its policy rate at 3.75% with a dovish tone versus market pricing, but ING economists now expect a hike in November due to higher inflation forecasts and elevated global energy prices.

item.title: Euro extends gains, nearing 181.00 against Japanese Yen despite Ueda's hawkish comments
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends gains against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Friday, after some hesitation, amid the Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Ueda's hawkish rhetoric at the post-meeting press conference.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Rallies to two-week top, above 210.50 amid post-BoJ JPY selloff
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross builds on its strong intraday rally and climbs to a nearly two-week top, above mid-210.00s during the early European session on Friday. Spot prices now seem poised to register gains for the first time in three weeks.

item.title: Dow Jones futures rise as 10-year US yield slides, tech rally resumes
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.25% to trade near 51,940 during European hours on Friday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures advance by 0.34% to trade around 7,670, while Nasdaq 100 futures rise by 0.64% to trade near 29,630.

item.title: Equities: Global rally extends with tech leadership – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank highlights a broad-based rebound in global equities following a drop in Oil prices and supportive US data. The S&P 500 and NASDAQ led gains in US stocks, while the STOXX 600 advanced in Europe and major Asian indices, including the Nikkei and KOSPI, moved higher.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as US Dollar gains on hawkish Fed outlook
item.description: NZD/USD depreciates after posting gains the previous day, trading around 0.5720 during the early European hours on Friday. The pair loses ground as the US Dollar (USD) recovers its daily losses due to hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Euro: Dollar weakness delayed as Fed stays hawkish – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that EUR/USD stabilized after the Federal Reserve’s hawkish surprise, with markets now fully pricing another Fed rate hike in December and no cuts until late next year.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Dovish BoJ hike keeps Yen vulnerable – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky reports that the Bank of Japan delivered a 25bp hike to 1.25% in a split decision, acknowledging persistent inflation risks but with notable dissent.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles near two-week low vs USD after BoJ Governor Ueda’s comments
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trims a part of strong intraday gains to a two-week high, though it holds comfortably above mid-156.00s during the post-meeting Bank of Japan (BoJ) press conference.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Holds gains near 1.4000, bullish signals support upside
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3995 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) extends its rally against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on a hawkish tone from the US Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: Ueda Speech: BoJ Governor sheds lights policy outlook after the expected interest rate hike
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda is addressing the press conference, explaining the reason behind raising the key interest rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 1.25% from 1.00% at the September meeting.

item.title: British Pound: Downside risk extends toward 1.3300 – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights that GBP/USD remains under pressure after four consecutive daily declines, though short-term momentum has not intensified. Intraday, the British Pound (GBP) is expected to range between 1.3335 and 1.3390.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rallies to near $66.80 amid correction in oil prices, US yields
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its upside on Friday, trading 2.26% higher at around 66.80 during the European session. The white metal strengthens due to correction in oil prices and United States (US) Treasury Yields.

item.title: Euro declines against British Pound following UK Retail Sales, German Producer Price data
item.description: EUR/GBP inches lower after three days of gains, trading around 0.8590 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency cross is facing downward pressure as the British Pound (GBP) gains momentum following stronger-than-expected United Kingdom (UK) Retail Sales data.

item.title: British Pound languishes at seven-week lows despite bright UK Retail Sales data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) has ticked up against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, following an unexpected increase in UK Retail Sales.
